intake.q1: Welcome to BMW. Would you like to tell me what you are looking for in your next luxury SUV, or shall we get started with the BMW X7 tour?

state_questions.question: Would you prefer to explore the turbocharged petrol performance or the individual second-row seating first?
Are you looking for specific technical data on the engine torque and mild hybrid, or would you like to review driving assistance?
Shall we examine how the six-seat configuration and luggage space match your family travel routines?

plan.json.do_not_recommend_if: You need a compact city runabout for narrow lanes or require an immediate diesel variant rather than an inline-six petrol mild hybrid.
plan.json.advance: Use the Request Dealer Contact button to connect with an authorised BMW dealer for local on-road pricing and a test-drive booking.

lines.text: In India, the BMW X7 is offered as the xDrive40i M Sport, built around a petrol forty-eight-volt mild-hybrid inline-six.

Let me take you through the petrol powertrain, the driver assistance and the cabin. We’ll look at the published acceleration figure, lane-return support and temperature settings across all three rows.
Let’s talk about the engine. The X7 xDrive40i uses a three-litre petrol inline-six with mild-hybrid technology; BMW lists its output at 280 kilowatts, or 381 horsepower.
Now for the acceleration figure: BMW lists zero to a hundred kilometres per hour in 5.8 seconds, alongside 540 Newton-metres of combined-system torque from the mild-hybrid powertrain.

deeper.text: The petrol engine’s own nominal torque is five hundred twenty Nm across one thousand eight hundred fifty to five thousand rpm.
The mild-hybrid electric motor is listed at nine kW, or twelve hp, and two hundred Nm; BMW also states a two hundred fifty kilometre-an-hour top speed.

segments.title: Road stance and xDrive poise
segments.outcome: Stable road presence and all-wheel traction

lines.text: Take a look at the side profile. The X7 is 5,181 millimetres long, with a 3,105-millimetre wheelbase—the measurement between its axles, shown along the side of the vehicle.

deeper.text: For width, BMW lists two thousand mm excluding mirrors and two thousand two hundred eighteen mm including mirrors.
The stated height is one thousand eight hundred thirty-five mm, with a curb weight of two thousand four hundred ninety kg.

lines.text: Driving Assistant includes Lane Change Warning with active lane return, plus Rear Crossing Traffic Warning with brake function; I’d treat these as assistance, not guaranteed avoidance.

deeper.text: Driving Assistant also includes Rear Collision Prevention, listed together with lane-change warning and rear crossing traffic warning with brake function.
Parking Assistant Professional first needs you to perform the manoeuvre once; on request, the car parks or leaves while you monitor close by on a smartphone.

lines.text: Let’s look at the rear seating: two individual seats form the second row, with a third row behind. The X7 has six seats across the cabin in total.
Look at the console’s CraftedClarity detail. The selector lever, BMW Controller and Start/Stop button use hand-made crystal glass; the close-up shows their shapes and finish.

deeper.text: The automatic air conditioning is listed with five-zone control, giving individual temperature setting in all three rows.
BMW publishes luggage capacity at seven hundred fifty to one thousand fifty litres on the technical-data page.

lines.text: Have a look at the display. Augmented View puts route-guidance information over live video in the control display or instrument cluster, placing the directions onto the road image.

deeper.text: The head-up display is a separate listed feature, projecting navigation and driving information directly into the driver’s field of vision.
The Harman Kardon surround sound system is listed with sixteen speakers and four hundred sixty-four W output; confirm the chosen India vehicle configuration.

lines.text: For the buying conversation, BMW publishes ₹1,33,40,000 ex-showroom as the X7 starting price; dealer offers, taxes and final state-wise figures need current confirmation before you order locally.

deeper.text: The standard vehicle warranty is twenty-four months with no mileage limit, starting from the first drive, registration, invoice or possession, whichever comes first.
BMW India Financial Services lists Smart, Bullet, Balloon and Standard plans; the FAQ tenure range is twelve to eighty-four months.

lines.text: The BMW Roof Box 520 adds separate 520-litre roof-box capacity in Black or Titanium Silver; BMW asks you to confirm its price with a Sales Consultant.

deeper.text: The roof rack mount limit without roof rails is one hundred kg, and that is separate from the accessory roof-box capacity.
For towing, BMW lists a braked trailer load of two thousand seven hundred kg up to twelve percent incline, with one hundred forty kg towbar download.

segments.title: Ownership checks and warranty scope
segments.outcome: Documented warranty terms and verified open items

lines.text: For warranty planning, the optional paid extended warranty is for new cars only; package price, kilometre limits and current scope need written confirmation before you choose.

deeper.text: The optional paid extended warranty is for new cars, normally purchased within the standard warranty period; extensions of an existing package are the stated exception. Cover ends at the chosen time or kilometre limit, whichever comes first. The supplied details do not give package prices or kilometre limits; written exclusions and current package terms need confirmation.
Paint warranty is three years for the painted surface, excluding damage from external or environmental factors; rust perforation cover has its own exclusions and inspection requirements.

closing.text: The X7 story here is a petrol mild-hybrid powertrain, six seats, listed driver assistance and Augmented View to examine closely.
